acceptanceCovered: A new auth.users row gets exactly one sunners row with user_id = its id, created by an after-insert trigger — proof: auto-provision-sunner.test.sql trigger_is + tgtype=5 (AFTER INSERT ROW), 12 inserts -> 12 rows, no duplicates; evidence/phase1-2-gotrue-path-check.txt real GoTrue admin sign-up provisioned one row

full_name follows ALG-007: full_name, else name, else email local part, else 'Sunner', trimmed and capped at 100 chars; avatar_url is avatar_url else picture only when https and at most 2048 chars, else null — proof: migration :17-29; pgTAP cases 1-12 (NBSP/tab/newline trim, 103->100 chars, null meta/email, scalar meta, http/javascript/uppercase dropped, 2048 kept/2049 dropped); mutation check killed

Existing auth users without a sunner are backfilled once by the migration; seeded sunners stay unlinked — proof: migration :47-52; pgTAP runs the same statement twice (2 then 0 inserted), backfilled rows follow ALG-007, seeded rows unchanged and user_id-null count preserved

The trigger function is SECURITY DEFINER with search_path '' and not executable by public, anon or authenticated; sunners.user_id stays hidden from authenticated — proof: pg_proc prosecdef/proconfig asserts; has_function_privilege false for anon/authenticated; no PUBLIC aclexplode entry; revoke at :54-55 after both blanket grants and no later migration; throws_ok 42501 on select user_id as authenticated

A freshly provisioned user can create a kudo and like a kudo through the existing RPCs; the no-sunner backstop paths still work — proof: pgTAP viewer_sunner_id resolves, create_kudo stores sender = provisioned row, toggle_kudo_like returns liked; sunner_not_found cases in kudos-like-rules and write-kudo-create-rules plus feed/sidebar no-sunner in kudos-rls-and-reads still pass
Existing pgTAP and e2e suites stay green — proof: evidence/final-pgtap-output.txt 302/302 in 7 files PASS; evidence/final-e2e-output.txt 252 passed; db lint 'No schema errors found'

findings.summary: Email sign-up enabled (confirmations off locally): the auth.users trigger at supabase/migrations/20261015035950_auto_provision_sunner.sql:42-44 now gives any anon-key /signup (non-Google, even unconfirmed) a searchable, write-capable sunner with attacker-chosen name and avatar host. Fix: [auth.email] enable_signup = false (local + hosted) or a provider = 'google' gate in provision_sunner
Avatar accepts any https host; limiting to googleusercontent closes the third-party tracking-pixel path
Cut to 100 chars happens after the trim, so a trailing space or split combining sequence can remain; trim again after left()
D013 'no auto-create' and related lines in technical-spec.md:704, project-changelog.md:30, permissions-matrix.md:387 are stale until the plan's spec draft is promoted
Pre-existing on delete set null: a deleted auth user leaves an orphan sunner and re-sign-up creates a second persona
